title: MingCute Screenshot Quality Recovery batch 065
review_goal: Differentiate hat, heartbeat, and hemisphere variants with screenshot grounded depicts and deterministic evidence fields.

items.depicts_observation: Fedora hat silhouette with one centered crown crease above a wide brim
items.context_bias: Use when the interface wants a brimmed fedora style hat with a centered crown shape.
items.ambiguity_note: Do not use for the baseball cap when the brim should project forward from one side.
items.selection_reason: The screenshot shows a full brim hat with a centered crown and no side visor.

items.depicts_observation: Baseball cap silhouette with one visor extending left and one top button
items.context_bias: Use when the interface wants a baseball cap with a side visor and panel seams.
items.ambiguity_note: Do not use for the fedora hat when the brim should wrap evenly around the base.
items.selection_reason: The screenshot angles the hat into a cap with a left visor and one button on top.

items.depicts_observation: Heartbeat line trace with one tall peak centered between flat segments
items.context_bias: Use when the interface wants a raw heartbeat trace without any enclosing heart shape.
items.ambiguity_note: Do not use for the heart outline pulse when the trace should run inside a heart border.
items.selection_reason: The screenshot is only the pulse trace with no surrounding symbol around it.

items.depicts_observation: Heart outline with one heartbeat line trace crossing the center
items.context_bias: Use when the interface wants a heartbeat trace enclosed inside a heart outline.
items.ambiguity_note: Do not use for the plain heartbeat line when no heart border should appear.
items.selection_reason: The screenshot wraps the pulse trace inside a clear heart outline.

items.depicts_observation: Half sphere bowl shape with one oval rim above a lower curved shell
items.context_bias: Use when the interface wants a horizontal half sphere or bowl viewed from the front.
items.ambiguity_note: Do not use for the side hemisphere when the half sphere should stand upright on its side.
items.selection_reason: The screenshot shows a bowl like half sphere with the rim ellipse above the lower shell.
